name: Remarqz Professional Review Management for WordPress
author: edice

sections.description:
Complete one-click customer expression solution for WordPress websites. Three authentic review options: AI-assisted customer articulation, manual writing, and Google Business integration. Professional customization in 40+ languages with SEO optimization and fully responsive widgets. Perfect for businesses wanting genuine customer feedback without complex setup. Install in 2 minutes, customize to match your brand, and start collecting authentic customer experiences immediately. No coding required.

Why Remarqz is Different:

• Complete Solution – AI creation + Google collection + professional display in one plugin
• One-Click Simplicity – 2-minute installation, instant activation
• All-in-One Integration – Everything you need without multiple plugins

Key Features:

• Professional Review Collection & Display – Streamlined customer feedback management
• AI-Assisted Customer Expression – Helps customers articulate their authentic experiences
• Google Review Integration – Seamless connection with Google Business Profile
• Multi-Language Support – 40+ languages for global businesses
• Complete Customization – Colors, styling, and widget personalization
• Negative Review Management – Professional response and moderation tools
• Unlimited Review Capacity – No limits on authentic customer feedback
• SEO Optimization – Boost search rankings with structured review data

Watch the tutorial video here:
View Video (Opens in New Tab)

Pricing & Plans

  • Remarqz Freemium

    • **Unlimited AI and regular reviews, max.6 are shown on the App.
    • **Ai review generator.
    • **English Version.
    • **QR code: Scan and go directly to the Review App.

  • Remarqz Review Yearly Plan

    • **€3⁹⁵/month
    • **Very affordable.
    • **Unlimited and very complete.
    • **Making a review was never so joyfull.
    • **You will be amazed by the result.

  • Remarqz Review Monthly Plan

    • **€8⁹⁵/month
    • **Very affordable.
    • **Unlimited and very complete.
    • **Making a review was never so joyfull.
    • **You will be amazed by the result.

External Services

This plugin connects to external APIs to provide review-related functionalities.

  • Fetch Domain-Specific Reviews (https://api.aireviewcreator.com/api/reviews?domain=(endpoint))

    • Purpose: Retrieves reviews specific to a given domain.
    • Data Sent: The website domain name is sent as a query parameter.
    • Data Received: Reviews associated with the provided domain.
    • Privacy Policy: (https://www.remarqz.com/_files/ugd/963c7d_edc58494b8b44290ab26340c1d32f648.pdf)

  • CSS Customization API (https://api.aireviewcreator.com/api/get-customize-css?domain=(endpoint))

    • Purpose: Fetches custom CSS settings for styling the review widget based on the domain.
    • Data Sent: The website domain name is sent as a query parameter.
    • Data Received: Returns CSS styling configurations.
    • Privacy Policy: (https://www.remarqz.com/_files/ugd/963c7d_edc58494b8b44290ab26340c1d32f648.pdf)

  • Submit Reviews (https://api.aireviewcreator.com/api/review)

    • Purpose: Submits user reviews to the AI Review Creator platform.
    • Data Sent: Review content, user rating, and relevant metadata.
    • Data Received: A response confirming successful submission.
    • Privacy Policy: (https://www.remarqz.com/_files/ugd/963c7d_edc58494b8b44290ab26340c1d32f648.pdf)

  • Fetch Reviews (https://api.aireviewcreator.com/api/reviews)

    • Purpose: Retrieves a list of reviews from the AI Review Creator database.
    • Data Sent: No personal data is sent, only a request to fetch existing reviews.
    • Data Received: A collection of reviews related to the website.
    • Privacy Policy: (https://www.remarqz.com/_files/ugd/963c7d_edc58494b8b44290ab26340c1d32f648.pdf)

  • Fetch Overall Rating (https://api.aireviewcreator.com/api/rating)

    • Purpose: Retrieves the average rating for the reviews associated with a domain.
    • Data Sent: No personal data is sent, only a request to fetch aggregated rating data.
    • Data Received: Returns the overall rating score.
    • Privacy Policy: (https://www.remarqz.com/_files/ugd/963c7d_edc58494b8b44290ab26340c1d32f648.pdf)

  • Plugin Activation Webhook (https://api.remarqz.com/api/app-activated-webhook)

    • Purpose: This API is used to send domain name, user email to requested URL.
    • Data Sent: Website URL, plugin activation details.
    • Data Received: Returns the plugin redirection URL.
    • Privacy Policy: (https://www.remarqz.com/_files/ugd/963c7d_edc58494b8b44290ab26340c1d32f648.pdf)

  • Translation Service (https://portal.remarqz.com/frontend/translations.json)

    • Purpose: Fetches language translations for the plugin’s frontend UI elements.
    • Data Sent: No personal data is sent; only a request to retrieve translation data.
    • Data Received: A JSON file containing language translations for different UI elements.
    • Privacy Policy: (https://www.remarqz.com/_files/ugd/963c7d_edc58494b8b44290ab26340c1d32f648.pdf)

  • Vimeo API (vimeo.com/api/v2/video/(video_idt).json)

    • Purpose: Fetches video thumbnail images for Vimeo-hosted videos.
    • Data Sent: Video ID.
    • Data Received: Thumbnail URL.
    • Privacy Policy: (https://vimeo.com/privacy)
    • Terms of Service: (https://vimeo.com/terms)

  • Vzaar API (vzaar.com/api/videos/(endpoint).json)

    • Purpose: Fetches video thumbnail images for Vzaar-hosted videos.
    • Data Sent: Video ID.
    • Data Received: Thumbnail URL.
    • Privacy Policy: (https://www.brightcove.com/legal/privacy/)
    • Terms of Service: (https://www.brightcove.com/terms-and-conditions/)
sections.installation:
1. Open the following link in your WordPress admin (replace yourdomain.com with your own domain):
    https://yourdomain.com/wp-admin/plugin-install.php?s=remarqz&tab=search&type=term

    Example:
    https://example.com/wp-admin/plugin-install.php?s=remarqz&tab=search&type=term

  2. Locate Remarqz Professional Review Management for WordPress in the search results and click Install Now.

  3. After installation, select Upload Plugin in the top left corner.

  4. The upload will be processed automatically.

  5. Once completed, the Remarqz portal will open for further setup and personalization.
